`, indistinguishable from a loading/error state. I replaced it with a proper empty-state panel: a dashed-border card with a centered icon badge (reusing the sidebar's `▤` glyph, since this app has no icon library), a bold "No posts yet" heading, and the original explanatory sentence beneath it — styled in `PostListPage.module.css` using the app's existing palette (navy `#1f2a44`, gray `#5b6472`, border `#dfe3ea`/`#c9cfdb`). Only the intended files are changed now. ## Summary The empty-posts state in `src/routes/PostListPage.tsx` was a single bare `

`, indistinguishable from a loading/error state. I replaced it with a proper empty-state panel: a dashed-border card with a centered icon badge (reusing the sidebar's `▤` glyph, since this app has no icon library), a bold "No posts yet" heading, and the original explanatory sentence beneath it — styled in `PostListPage.module.css` using the app's existing palette (navy `#1f2a44`, gray `#5b6472`, border `#dfe3ea`/`#c9cfdb`). No "create post" CTA was added since that flow doesn't exist anywhere in the app yet (confirmed via `App.tsx` routes) — adding one would be a separate feature, not a visual fix. Verified with `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` (29/29 passing — the one unrelated error is a missing Playwright browser binary in this sandbox, pre-existing), and `vite build`.
